body:
`filemark:datagrid:<storageKey>` → `{ _v, sorting, columnFilters,
columnVisibility, columnSizing, density, grouping, expanded,
globalFilter }`.

`filemark:datagrid:<storageKey>:cell:<rowId>:<colKey>` → boolean (only
used by interactive `checkbox` cells; `rowId` comes from the `id` column).

`storageKey` = `<fileId>:<lang>:<fnv1a(rawBody + meta)>` — changes
when the block's content or info-string changes.
